headline: Public hearings on new all-alcoholic liquor licenses at 211 Worthington Street and 1655 Boston Road.
summary: Yaadstop Bar & Grill, LLC and Beyond Oishii, Inc. are asking for new all-alcoholic liquor licenses. The agenda also lists non-subdivision plans and board elections.
items: Public hearing: new all-alcoholic liquor license at 211 Worthington Street, petitioner Yaadstop Bar & Grill, LLC, d/b/a Yaadstop Bar & Grill
Public hearing: new all-alcoholic liquor license at 1655 Boston Road, petitioner Beyond Oishii, Inc.
